records.context: Painting image data channels are named after the stain (``CorrDNA``, ``CorrER``, ``CorrMito``, ``CorrPhalloidin``, ``CorrWGA``); sequencing image data channels are ``Cycle<CC>_<base>`` for each cycle and base, plus ``Cycle01_DAPI``. The painting and sequencing extracted image regions of a site share one pixel grid and are already illumination-corrected, and the sequencing cycles are aligned to each other, so this reader stacks them as they are: no stitching, no cycle registration, no rescaling. The painting extracted image regions are NOT in the sequencing frame: PERISCOPE's 04Align moves them onto Cycle01_DAPI at analysis time (3-77 px on CP186A Well1). :func:`painting_to_sbs_shift` gives that shift per site, and the prefix decode applies it to painting-frame labels (``ops_prefix_masks_frame 'painting'``).
records.label: spacr.cpg_cropped#2
records.source: Painting channels are named after the stain (``CorrDNA``, ``CorrER``, ``CorrMito``, ``CorrPhalloidin``, ``CorrWGA``); sequencing channels are ``Cycle<CC>_<base>`` for each cycle and base, plus ``Cycle01_DAPI``. The painting and sequencing crops of a site share one pixel grid and are already illumination-corrected, and the sequencing cycles are aligned to each other, so this reader stacks them as they are: no stitching, no cycle registration, no rescaling. The painting crops are NOT in the sequencing frame: PERISCOPE's 04Align moves them onto Cycle01_DAPI at analysis time (3-77 px on CP186A Well1). :func:`painting_to_sbs_shift` gives that shift per site, and the prefix decode applies it to painting-frame labels (``ops_prefix_masks_frame 'painting'``).
records.translation: Litunarrásir eru nefndar eftir lituninni (``CorrDNA``, ``CorrER``, ``CorrMito``, ``CorrPhalloidin``, ``CorrWGA``); raðgreiningarrásir eru ``Cycle<CC>_<base>`` fyrir hverja umferð og basa, auk ``Cycle01_DAPI``. Litunar- og raðgreiningarútskurðir svæðis deila einu dílaneti og hafa þegar verið leiðréttir fyrir lýsingu, og raðgreiningarumferðirnar eru samstilltar hver við aðra. Lesarinn staflar þeim því óbreyttum: engin samskeyting, engin skráning umferða, engin stærðarbreyting. Litunarútskurðirnir eru EKKI í hnitakerfi raðgreiningar: 04Align í PERISCOPE færir þá yfir á Cycle01_DAPI við greiningu (3-77 px á CP186A Well1). :func:`painting_to_sbs_shift` gefur þessa hliðrun fyrir hvert svæði og forskeytisafkóðunin beitir henni á merki í hnitakerfi litunar (``ops_prefix_masks_frame 'painting'``).
